info.name: SlidePrepper
info.summary: Turn a prompt into a PPTX slide deck
info.description: Turn a user prompt into a slide deck. A language model authors Marp Markdown from the prompt; the deck is built as an editable PPTX (default, native shapes, images via provided files), a standalone HTML presentation or a PDF document, with speaker notes (PDF output excludes them) and the Markdown source retained. A deterministic re-render task type rebuilds the deck from an edited Markdown source with no language model involved.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_TOTAL_LLM_TIMEOUT
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings): a value an admin saves there overrides this one and applies to new tasks within 30 seconds. Total time budget across BOTH inner LLM attempts (the first plus the self-correcting retry). Default: 1800.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_MAX_SLIDES
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). Upper bound of slides the model may author for one deck; per-task requests can only lower it. Default: 60.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_MAX_PROMPT_CHARS
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). Prompts longer than this are rejected before any LLM round. Default: 8192.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_DRAFTS_FOLDER
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). When set, failed and resumed decks also copy their current draft markdown into this folder of the requesting user's Files. Empty keeps drafts on the ExApp volume only. Default: empty.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_RETRY_LLM
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). One self-correcting retry when the deck fails extraction or strict validation; disable to fail at the first attempt. Default: true.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_OVERFLOW_CHECK
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). Measure every authored slide against its theme box and retry or shrink overflowing slides. Disable only when the headless renderer is unavailable on this instance. Default: true.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_LOG_EXCERPT
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). When a generated deck fails validation, log a 240-character excerpt of the extracted markdown (WARNING, deck content only) for diagnosability. Set to false to suppress the excerpt in privacy-sensitive deployments; the error line itself is always logged. Default: true.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_DRAFTS_ENABLED
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). Failed attempts keep their completed slides as a checkpoint so a follow-up task can resume; disable to always regenerate from scratch. Default: true.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_DESIGN_TOKENS_PATH
variable.description: Optional. Environment fallback for the admin setting of the same name (Administration settings, ExApps Settings). Path, relative to the requesting user's Files root, of the design tokens JSON whose colors and font re-brand the nextcloud theme for that user's decks. A missing or malformed file falls back to the instance theming. Default: SlidePrepper/design-tokens.json.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_POLL_INTERVAL
variable.description: Optional. How often the ExApp polls Nextcloud for new slide deck tasks when no trigger event has arrived. Not admin-manageable (worker loop cadence). Default: 5.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_MARP_TIMEOUT
variable.description: Optional. Timeout for each marp-cli conversion subprocess (HTML validation and PPTX rendering each). Internal per-round cap tied to the container runtime; not admin-manageable. Default: 120.

variable.name: SLIDEPREPPER_LLM_TIMEOUT
variable.description: Optional. Maximum time to wait for one nested core:text2text round. Internal per-round cap; the admin-facing knob is the total cap, so this one is not admin-manageable. Default: 300.
